summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K reporting September 2026 trading in its own securities and derivatives. The report shows no transactions during the month; holdings remained unchanged: 14,482,658 common shares (ON) held directly, 3,534,700 ON shares held via Minerações Brasileiras Reunidas, and 165,379,611 ADRs held via Vale Holdings B.V. Signed by Thiago Lofiego, Director of Investor Relations, dated October 13, 2026. This is an ordinary monthly securities-trading disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
